family: z=2q+u, q=indicator of{0,1} times a union M of mate pairs, u_i in{-1,0,1}, D_S*u=0, and the ten third-star-only entries are nonconstant. Q is required connected when constructing Gamma.
seven_states: For each outside letter x=4,...,13, the triple(u_0x,u_1x,u_2x) sums to zero. Its seven possibilities are(0,0,0) and the six permutations of(1,-1,0).
overlaps: Write a=u_02,b=u_12,c=u_03,d=u_13. The letter3 equation gives d=-c. Summing the outside-letter equations and the centre equations gives a+b=0. Therefore the outside triples sum to(-a-c,a+c,0). Conversely these conditions imply every equation D_S*u=0.
normalization: Swap centres0 and1 if needed to arrange a>0 or a=0,c>=0. This preserves q. Then independently flip each outside mate pair so its two seven-state indices are ordered. Finally sort the pair codes within M and outside M. These latter permutations preserve a,c and q, so the normalizations are compatible. Some residual repetitions can remain; no claim of exactly one representative per full isomorphism class is made.
finite_enumeration: There are28 unordered pairs of seven-state indices. For the tested2+3 and3+2 splits among the five outside mate pairs, enumerate the multisets in each part and retain the three sum conditions and nonzero tail. Both give194336 normalized templates. Weighting by mate-flip and within-part permutation orbit sizes gives38673438 labelled templates with the chosen canonical(a,c), matching a separate dynamic-program count over ten ordered seven-state columns.
row_filter: For each row of Gamma, choose its two overlap adjacencies in four possible ways. The three star equations then fix how many neighbours lie in each exclusive star group (at most two). The required kernel row sum must lie between the sum of the required smallest and largest z values in those groups, plus the overlap contribution. If every overlap choice fails, no binary Gamma row exists. This exact integer filter ignores consistency between rows and is only necessary.
outcomes: The row filter retains118848 templates for M={pairs2,3}, and104528 for M={pairs2,3,4}. The complete raw and normalized CP-SAT coefficient-family searches each stopped after40 seconds without a verdict. A short prefix LP search found two individual templates with connected Q feasible fractionally; each was then UNSAT in the binary model. None of these results excludes the whole bounded family or proves(A).
global_versus_local: The global binary minimum-distance obstruction is not imposed in the local(A) searches: a local PSD counterexample might itself be uncompletable. The prefix LP selections used odd weight>=10 only as a choice of which individual candidates to try, not as an exclusion of the others.
